platformHelp_telegram: Get a token from @BotFather on Telegram
platformHelp_feishu: Create an app at Feishu Open Platform

platformHelp_dingtalk: Create a bot at DingTalk Open Platform

platformGuide_dingtalk_1_body: Open DingTalk Developer Console and create an enterprise internal application.
platformGuide_dingtalk_2_body: Copy Client ID / AppKey and Client Secret / AppSecret into the form.
platformGuide_dingtalk_3_body: Enable the bot capability, save this configuration first, then configure Stream mode in DingTalk.
platformGuide_feishu_1_body: Use QR creation for the fastest setup, or create a custom app in Feishu Open Platform and copy App ID plus App Secret.
platformGuide_feishu_2_body: Open messaging permissions and subscribe to message events for private and group chats.
platformGuide_feishu_3_body: If your app has Verification Token or Encrypt Key enabled, enter them before connecting.
platformGuide_weixin_1_body: Use WeChat to scan the QR code. WorkCraft saves the returned bot token after confirmation.
platformGuide_weixin_2_body: If QR login is unavailable, paste an iLink bot token and connect manually.
platformGuide_weixin_3_body: Leave allowed senders as wildcard for testing, then restrict it to trusted WeChat user IDs.
platformGuide_wecom_1_body: Create an AI Bot in WeCom Admin Console and copy Bot ID plus Secret.
platformGuide_wecom_2_body: Optionally add a welcome message for first-time users.
platformGuide_qq_1_body: Create a bot in QQ Open Platform and copy App ID plus Secret.
platformGuide_telegram_1_body: Talk to @BotFather and create a Telegram bot.
platformGuide_telegram_2_body: Paste the bot token, then connect the channel.
